A.explanation: Upward forces sum to $30+50=80\text{ N}$ but downward force is $90\text{ N}$, so resultant force is not zero.

B.explanation: Resultant force is zero since $36+70=106\text{ N}$, but moments about the centre are $36\times 50=1800$ and $70\times 30=2100\text{ N cm}$, so resultant torque is not zero.

C.explanation: Resultant force is zero since $28+35=63\text{ N}$, but moments about the centre are $28\times 50=1400$ and $35\times 30=1050\text{ N cm}$, so resultant torque is not zero.

D.explanation: Upward forces sum to $42+70=112\text{ N}$ balancing the downward $112\text{ N}$, and moments $42\times 50$ and $70\times 30$ are both $2100\text{ N cm}$ and opposite, so both resultants are zero.

hints: Add the two upward forces on each beam in $\text{N}$ and compare with the single downward force of $90\text{ N}$, $106\text{ N}$, $63\text{ N}$ or $112\text{ N}$ to test for zero resultant force.
Take moments about the central downward force where its moment is zero, so compare left anticlockwise moment $F_{left}\times 50\text{ cm}$ with right clockwise moment $F_{right}\times 30\text{ cm}$.
Check which beam satisfies both $F_{left}+F_{right}=F_{down}$ and $F_{left}\times 50 = F_{right}\times 30$ with the values shown.
walkthrough: First test zero resultant force by taking upward as positive. Need $F_{left}+F_{right}-F_{down}=0$, so $F_{left}+F_{right}$ must equal the central downward force.
Beams B, C and D satisfy this: $36+70=106\text{ N}$, $28+35=63\text{ N}$, $42+70=112\text{ N}$. Beam A gives $30+50=80\text{ N}$ against $90\text{ N}$, so it cannot be in equilibrium.

Next test zero resultant torque. Choose the central downward force as pivot so it has zero moment. Then left $50\text{ cm}$ force gives an anticlockwise moment and right $30\text{ cm}$ force gives a clockwise moment.
Use $moment = force \times perpendicular distance$. Need $F_{left}\times 50\text{ cm}=F_{right}\times 30\text{ cm}$ for balance.

For D: left moment $=42\times 50=2100\text{ N cm}$ and right moment $=70\times 30=2100\text{ N cm}$. They are equal and opposite, so resultant torque is zero while resultant force is $42+70-112=0\text{ N}$. This is option D
